import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 205;
    static final int MAXM = MAXN * MAXN;
    
    static int[] prev_edge = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] mark_node = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] head_node = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] from_edge = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] cap_edge = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] to_edge = new int[MAXM];
    static int edge_count = 0;
    
    static int[][] gridA = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] gridB = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] red_cell = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] block_cell = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dist_grid = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dist_red = new int[MAXN * MAXN];
    static int[] visited_bfs = new int[MAXN * MAXN];
    static int[][] bfs_queue = new int[MAXN * MAXN][2];
    
    static final int[] DX = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static final int[] DY = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    
    static void insertEdge(int u, int v, int uv_cap, int vu_cap) {
        from_edge[edge_count] = u;
        to_edge[edge_count] = v;
        cap_edge[edge_count] = uv_cap;
        prev_edge[edge_count] = head_node[u];
        head_node[u] = edge_count++;
        from_edge[edge_count] = v;
        to_edge[edge_count] = u;
        cap_edge[edge_count] = vu_cap;
        prev_edge[edge_count] = head_node[v];
        head_node[v] = edge_count++;
    }
    
    static int dfsFlow(int vertex, int sink, int flow_limit) {
        if (vertex == sink) return flow_limit;
        if (mark_node[vertex] != 0) return 0;
        mark_node[vertex] = 1;
        for (int e = head_node[vertex]; e != -1; e = prev_edge[e]) {
            if (cap_edge[e] > 0) {
                int neighbor = to_edge[e];
                int augment = dfsFlow(neighbor, sink, Math.min(flow_limit, cap_edge[e]));
                if (augment > 0) {
                    cap_edge[e] -= augment;
                    cap_edge[e ^ 1] += augment;
                    return augment;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int computeMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        int total = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(mark_node, 0);
            int added = dfsFlow(source, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            total += added;
            if (added == 0) break;
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int dt = sc.nextInt();
        
        Arrays.fill(head_node, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_grid[i], 63);
            dist_grid[i][i] = 0;
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c == 'Y') block_cell[x][y] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z') red_cell[x][y] = 1;
                else gridA[x][y] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    gridB[x][y] = c - '0';
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + DX[d];
                        int ny = y + DY[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                            block_cell[nx][ny] == 0 && red_cell[nx][ny] == 0) {
                            dist_grid[x * n + y][nx * n + ny] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int total_nodes = n * n;
        for (int k = 0; k < total_nodes; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < total_nodes; j++) {
                    if (dist_grid[i][k] + dist_grid[k][j] < dist_grid[i][j]) {
                        dist_grid[i][j] = dist_grid[i][k] + dist_grid[k][j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int front = 0, rear = 0;
        Arrays.fill(dist_red, 63);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red_cell[i][j] == 1) {
                    bfs_queue[rear][0] = i;
                    bfs_queue[rear][1] = j;
                    rear++;
                    dist_red[i * n + j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (front != rear) {
            int x = bfs_queue[front][0];
            int y = bfs_queue[front][1];
            front++;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + DX[d];
                int ny = y + DY[d];
                int nid = nx * n + ny;
                if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                    block_cell[nx][ny] == 0 && red_cell[nx][ny] == 0 && 
                    dist_red[nid] > 1e9) {
                    dist_red[nid] = dist_red[x * n + y] + 1;
                    bfs_queue[rear][0] = nx;
                    bfs_queue[rear][1] = ny;
                    rear++;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int sink_node = MAXN - 1;
        int source_node = MAXN - 2;
        
        for (int start_node = 0; start_node < total_nodes; start_node++) {
            Arrays.fill(visited_bfs, 0);
            front = 0;
            rear = 0;
            int sx = start_node / n;
            int sy = start_node % n;
            if (block_cell[sx][sy] == 1 || red_cell[sx][sy] == 1) continue;
            
            bfs_queue[rear][0] = sx;
            bfs_queue[rear][1] = sy;
            rear++;
            visited_bfs[start_node] = 1;
            
            while (front != rear) {
                int x = bfs_queue[front][0];
                int y = bfs_queue[front][1];
                front++;
                
                if (dist_grid[start_node][x * n + y] <= dt) {
                    insertEdge(start_node << 1, (x * n + y) << 1 | 1, 1000, 0);
                }
                
                if (dist_grid[start_node][x * n + y] == dist_red[x * n + y]) continue;
                
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nx = x + DX[d];
                    int ny = y + DY[d];
                    int nid = nx * n + ny;
                    if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                        block_cell[nx][ny] == 0 && red_cell[nx][ny] == 0 && 
                        dist_grid[start_node][nid] <= dist_red[nid] && 
                        dist_grid[start_node][nid] <= dt && 
                        dist_grid[start_node][nid] > dist_grid[start_node][x * n + y] && 
                        visited_bfs[nid] == 0) {
                        bfs_queue[rear][0] = nx;
                        bfs_queue[rear][1] = ny;
                        rear++;
                        visited_bfs[nid] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
            insertEdge(source_node, i << 1, gridA[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
            insertEdge((i << 1) | 1, sink_node, gridB[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        
        System.out.println(computeMaxFlow(source_node, sink_node));
    }
}
